patterns: APPSC asks bare historical figures: 1950-51 GDP growth 3.6%, industry 13% of GDP in 1950-51, agriculture largest sector at Independence.
Recent-year growth figures as first published (2014-15, 2023-24 = 8.2%) - the key follows the estimate of the time, not later revisions.
Report-to-agency pairs recur across PSCs: Global Economic Prospects = World Bank, World Economic Outlook = IMF.
App leans heavily on 2025-26 current data (new GDP series, Q1 2026-27, S&P upgrade, 16th FC) - more numerous than the PYQ pattern but consistent with it.
